collection.title: Toyota Proace Van 2013 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Toyota Proace Van 2013 to 2015 uses a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" wiper blade on the passengers side. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
